7173: function _M:removeEffectsFilter(src, t, nb, silent, force, check_remove, allow_immunity)
7174: 	if allow_immunity == nil then allow_immunity = true end
7175: 	t = t or {}
7176: 	local eff_ids = self:effectsFilter(t, nb)
7177: 	for _, eff_id in ipairs(eff_ids) do
7178: 		if not check_remove or check_remove(self, eff_id) then
7179: 			self:dispel(eff_id, src, not force and allow_immunity, {force=force, silent=silent})
7180: 		end
7181: 	end
7182: 	return #eff_ids
7183: end

7295: function _M:dispel(effid_or_tid, src, allow_immunity, params)
7296: 	if not params then params = {} end
7297: 	if params.silent == nil then params.silent = false end
7298: 	if params.force == nil then params.force = false end
7299: 	if params.ignore_energy == nil then params.ignore_energy = true end
7300: 	if allow_immunity == nil then allow_immunity = true end
7301: 	local allowed = true
7302: 
7303: 	-- Dont resist yourself!
7304: 	if src == self then allow_immunity = false end
7305: 
7306: 	if allow_immunity and self:attr("invulnerable") then return end
7307: 
7308: 	-- Effect
7309: 	if effid_or_tid:find("^EFF_") then
7310: 		local eff = self:getEffectFromId(effid_or_tid)
7311: 		if (not eff or eff.type == "other") and not params.force then return end -- NEVER touch other
7312: 		if not self:hasEffect(effid_or_tid) then return end
7313: 
7314: 		if allow_immunity then
7315: 			if not self:canBe("dispel_effects") then allowed = false end
7316: 		end
7317: 		if allowed and allow_immunity then
7318: 			if self:fireTalentCheck("callbackOnDispel", "effect", effid_or_tid, src, allow_immunity, eff.desc) then allowed = false end
7319: 		end
7320: 		if allowed then
7321: 			self:fireTalentCheck("callbackOnDispelled", "effect", effid_or_tid, src, allow_immunity, eff.desc)
7322: 			self:removeEffect(effid_or_tid, params.silent, params.force)
7323: 			return true

source_conclusion: DLC cleanActor removes up to floor(effective talent level) detrimental physical effects and consumes 15 steam; it sets no general burning/fire immunity. The retained injector clause is user-approved flavor limited to this overheating event, not a claim of a general immunity implementation. Core BURNING is detrimental physical, so it is eligible for bounded removal, not guaranteed removal. DLC source/commit remains unpinned.
